findings.detail: Stored distribution_rate is 37.602%, but source annual Class I distributions of 1.5109 per share over Dec. 31 NAV of 14.43 imply about 10.47%, within the rule range.

rationale: F33 is an aggregate fund_financials rate check. The raw source distribution schedule reports 2025 Class I total distributions of $1.5109 per share and $51.541 million, and the NAV schedule reports December 31, 2025 Class I NAV per share of $14.43. Those source anchors imply a distribution/NAV rate of approximately 10.47%, not the stored 37.602067%; therefore the flagged stored value is a real data error rather than a false alarm.
